title: The Userplace WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not perform authorization checks on an AJAX action available to…
description: The Userplace WordPress plugin versions up to 1.2.0 contain a vulnerability where an AJAX action accessible to unauthenticated users lacks proper authorization checks and exposes the nonce protecting it. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to create administrator accounts or modify site options, potentially resulting in full site takeover.
